caption: The drawing depicts a single, large, rounded pottery jar positioned centrally on a plain background. The jar is colored in shades of brown, with a speckled texture suggesting a coarse, unglazed surface. It has an outward-flaring rim, a short neck, and a broad body that gently tapers towards the flat base. One small, curved handle is visible on the upper right portion of the jar, near the neck. The mouth of the jar is wide and shows slight chips or irregularities along the rim. There is a thin rectangular border drawn around the jar, and the name "Annie B. Johnston" is written in the lower right corner outside the border. The background remains unadorned and a neutral off-white in color.
title: Stoneware Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
